1. ABOUT S.L.C SOLUTIONS & CORE VALUE PROPOSITION
OVERVIEW
Q: What is S.L.C Solutions and what does this platform do?
S.L.C Solutions (Sri Lankan Construction Solutions) is an open B2B digital marketplace designed for Sri Lanka's construction
industry. It connects hardware suppliers, raw material manufacturers, building contractors, and small businesses to trade directly,

industry. It connects hardware suppliers, raw material manufacturers, building contractors, and small businesses to trade directly,
negotiate formal contracts, and get wholesale pricing without relying on informal Facebook/WhatsApp groups or middlemen.
PRICING & FEES
Q: Is it free to use, or do you charge commissions?
Browsing the open discovery feed and creating an account is completely free. Small businesses and startups can publish posts and

Browsing the open discovery feed and creating an account is completely free. Small businesses and startups can publish posts and
receive contract proposals with zero upfront listing fees. There are no hidden subscription charges for standard discovery and
contract negotiations.
VERIFICATION
Q: Are the suppliers and contractors on this platform verified?
Yes. Every registered business profile displays their Business Registration (BR) status, contact information, location, product

Yes. Every registered business profile displays their Business Registration (BR) status, contact information, location, product
specifications, and past transaction records so buyers can verify supplier authenticity before proposing a contract.
2. BUYER & CONTRACTOR GUIDE (HOW TO BUY & NEGOTIATE)
ORDERING
Q: How do I place an order for materials (cement, steel, sand, hardware)?

2. BUYER & CONTRACTOR GUIDE (HOW TO BUY & NEGOTIATE)
ORDERING
Q: How do I place an order for materials (cement, steel, sand, hardware)?
Instead of a simple "add-to-cart", you use our Contract Proposal Wizard. Find the vendor or material you want, specify the exact
quantity needed, propose your target price (LKR), and set your required delivery deadline. The vendor then receives the proposal
instantly and can accept, counter, or reject it.
NEGOTIATION

instantly and can accept, counter, or reject it.
NEGOTIATION
Q: Can I negotiate prices and custom delivery timelines?
Yes! S.L.C Solutions features a multi-state negotiation engine. If a vendor cannot meet your proposed price or delivery date, they can
send a Counter-Offer with modified terms. You can review the counter-terms and accept or decline directly from your Buyer Portal.
MOQ & POOLING

MOQ & POOLING
Q: I need small quantities, but distributors have large Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ). Can I still buy?
Yes! S.L.C Solutions provides an Order Pooling Intent feature. If you only need 200 kg of a material with a 2,000 kg distributor

Yes! S.L.C Solutions provides an Order Pooling Intent feature. If you only need 200 kg of a material with a 2,000 kg distributor
MOQ, you can register a pooling request. The system connects multiple small buyers together to collectively satisfy wholesale MOQ
thresholds and unlock bulk prices.
LEGAL & RECEIPTS
Q: Do I get a formal bill, invoice, or purchase order?
Yes. Once a deal is accepted and marked as completed, the platform automatically generates an official, downloadable PDF

Yes. Once a deal is accepted and marked as completed, the platform automatically generates an official, downloadable PDF
Purchase Order containing all agreed quantities, unit prices, delivery terms, tax info, and business credentials.

ALERTS
Q: How do I know if the vendor responded to my offer?
You do not need to keep checking the website. The moment a supplier counters or accepts your deal, instant alerts are delivered to
your mobile phone via WhatsApp, Telegram, or Email based on your account settings.
3. VENDOR, SUPPLIER & MANUFACTURER GUIDE (HOW TO SELL & GROW)
GETTING STARTED
Q: How can I register my hardware shop or manufacturing business?

3. VENDOR, SUPPLIER & MANUFACTURER GUIDE (HOW TO SELL & GROW)
GETTING STARTED
Q: How can I register my hardware shop or manufacturing business?
Sign up through the Vendor Registration page, provide your company details and Sri Lankan Business Registration (BR) number,
and access your Vendor Dashboard to add your inventory, materials, specifications, and pricing tiers.
PROMOTION
Q: How do new suppliers get discovered without paying for expensive ads?

PROMOTION
Q: How do new suppliers get discovered without paying for expensive ads?
We use an organic boostScore algorithm on our public discovery feed. Your ranking is determined by your activity, response speed,
posting frequency, and profile completeness. Active and responsive suppliers get top placement on the feed completely free of
charge.
INBOUND DEALS
Q: What happens when a buyer wants to buy my stock?

charge.
INBOUND DEALS
Q: What happens when a buyer wants to buy my stock?
You will receive an instant notification on WhatsApp/Telegram with the buyer's requested quantity, proposed price, and target
delivery date. In your Vendor Dashboard, you can accept the deal in one click, submit a counter-proposal, or decline.
SECURITY
Q: Is my business pricing and transaction data private?

SECURITY
Q: Is my business pricing and transaction data private?
Yes. Contract negotiations and private pricing agreements are strictly multi-tenant and encrypted between you and the specific
buyer. No third party or competitor can view your active negotiation terms.
